note: No entries yet. lowriskquotes publishes no externally sourced facts: its two Monte Carlo engines (three-point cost estimation and retirement drawdown) run on user inputs. The drawdown engine's capital-market assumptions (equity real return mean 5%, stdev 17%; bond real return mean 1.5%, stdev 6%; lognormal, annual steps) are fixed model choices disclosed in every /api/drawdown/ response, have not changed since the engine shipped on 2026-08-30, and are not read from an official source, so they are not itemised as verified changes. If they change, or are re-based on an authority's published figures, an entry will be appended here.

areas.name: drawdown-assumptions
areas.description: Capital-market assumptions used by the retirement drawdown engine (/api/drawdown/ and the MCP tool retirement_drawdown): real (after-inflation) return means and standard deviations for equities and bonds. Model choices, not official statistics; an entry is published only when one changes.
areas.cadence: On change only; reviewed whenever the engine is modified.
